name: Child Abandonment
overview: Scripture reveals God's compassionate heart toward children, especially those who are vulnerable or abandoned, portraying Him as a father to the fatherless and a protector who will never forsake His own (Psalms 68:5; Deuteronomy 31:6). The Lord's unwavering care is emphasized in Isaiah 49:15, where He assures that unlike a mother who might forget her child, He will never forget His children. Believers are called to honor and nurture children in the Lord's instruction (Ephesians 6:4), recognizing the grave responsibility to protect and not cause harm to them (Mark 9:42). This divine care extends beyond physical provision to spiritual guidance, guarding children from deception and instability (Ephesians 4:14).
